title: Speak a label to press a control
blurb: A panel of switches drawn through a shader. Say a name on it and that control is clicked, a ring spreads from it and the transcript highlights each word. The names of the controls drawn now are the phrases given to speech recognition.
question: Can speech recognition press controls that a shader draws, using only the accessible names in the DOM, and does a word-by-word transcript highlight reach the canvas?
result: Names read from the DOM drive the matching and the phrase list, and custom highlights are in the element's picture. Recognition itself couldn't be run in the test browser.
